site: Roehampton Lane Site (Digby Stuart, Froebel, Southlands)
positionNote: Building points sit inside their OpenStreetMap footprint (osm-footprint, about 5 m). Other points come from Google Maps (about 5-12 m) or the official campus map (about 20 m). Entrances still need picking on site.

places.description: A fountain in the middle of the round path in the garden north of Grove House, Froebel College.

places.name: Garden
places.description: A small garden east of Grove House, Froebel College, with a statue in the middle behind a low iron fence and flower beds around it.

places.name: Lyne-Stephens Mausoleum
places.description: A Grade II listed Romanesque mausoleum in the grounds of Grove House, Greek cross in plan. William Burn designed it for Yolande Lyne-Stephens in memory of her husband, who died in 1860; it was consecrated in 1864, and she was buried there in 1894.

sources.title: Historic England list entry 1184736: Mausoleum in grounds of Grove House (Grade II)
